fields.statement: Test your hooks, discuss a change: rhiza hook ls shows which hook commands are set and where from, rhiza hook run tries one with a sample, and notes attached to a node, a change set or one of its operations hold the discussion, shown by show and change show

fields.quote: just checking in. keep cracking on
fields.statement: Milestone 18 carves hook-commands out of the Area hooks umbrella and change-notes out of the Area change-sets umbrella; actor stamping is already landed and needs nothing

The daemon records its notify and event commands and where each came from (daemon flag or git config) in its state at start; rhiza hook ls lists notify and event with command and source, preferring a live daemon's values over git config, and unset otherwise; rhiza hook run <notify|event> [--command c] runs the command once with a sample payload through the daemon's own runner, prints its output and exit status, fails when it fails, exits 2 when unset, and writes nothing to the daemon's state
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A note is a new node kind, note, with no parent, its body in statement and an optional op field naming an operation ID, linked to what it discusses by a new link type discusses that may point at any node or change set; a note on an operation links to the operation's change set; rhiza note add <target> <text> [--op id] writes the note and its link in one entry with an automatic handle note-<short id>; show and change show list the notes that discuss them, oldest first, with actor and time
